A loud refusal beats an unhandled error that takes the job down. THE SECOND HALF MATTERS MORE THAN THE CRASH: `openerKind` now keys on the CLIENT WE BUILT rather than the TOKEN WE HOLD. Keying it on the token would report `pat` after a fallback and tell step 3 the checks attached when they did not -- arming a head nothing is measuring, which is the exact defect #11889 was written to prevent.
